heard: They faithfully brought in the contributions, the tithes and the dedicated gifts. Canania the Levite was in charge, managing every holy thing. His brother Shemai was second in command, serving under the king. 1 Jehiel and Azaziah served as supervisors, and Ahath and Azahel, too, by appointment of King Hezekiah and Azariah the official. They distributed the gifts fairly.
